description: This file defines a console command class 'DauxCommand' that extends Symfony's Command class. It provides methods to configure command-line options and prepare configuration and processing logic for the documentation generator tool 'Daux'.

classes.name: DauxCommand
classes.description: A console command class for configuring and running documentation processing tasks within the 'Daux' documentation generator tool.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command-line options for configuring the documentation generation process.

methods.name: prepareConfig
methods.description: Builds a ConfigBuilder instance based on CLI input options for further processing.

methods.name: prepareProcessor
methods.description: Initializes the processor for Daux if a processor class is specified.
